# Know exactly what you unlock.

Support Mythforge with a one-time rank purchase. Every supporter reward can also be earned through gameplay without spending money.

 [Ember - $8 USD](https://mythforge.win/#ember)  [Artisan - $16 USD](https://mythforge.win/#artisan)  [Runeforged - $32 USD](https://mythforge.win/#runeforged)  [Mythic - $64 USD](https://mythforge.win/#mythic)

## How ranks and upgrades work

The Minecraft server is live at **play.mythforge.win**. Apply for the  [server whitelist](https://mythforge.win/apply/)  and install the  [matching Mythforge pack](https://mythforge.win/getting-started/)  before joining. A rank purchase does not replace whitelist approval.

Ranks are permanent one-time purchases with no subscription or scheduled expiry. Higher ranks include lower-tier features. Tebex handles payment, final prices, applicable taxes and checkout availability. These are server rewards, not a purchase of Minecraft, the modpack, a mod licence or staff powers.

**Upgrades charge the eligible price difference.** Ember is $8, Artisan $16, Runeforged $32 and Mythic $64 USD. An Ember owner upgrading to Artisan pays $8 before applicable taxes. Sign in using the same Minecraft account so Tebex can calculate eligible credit; review the final amount before paying.

**Your natural home, public-warp, claim and force-load allowances are increased by your purchased rank's bonuses.** The highest purchased tier supplies one set of bonuses. For example, Artisan adds three homes in total; it does not add Ember's two again. Separately earned allowances remain yours.

Confirmed purchases are processed automatically through the official Tebex server integration. Permissions apply to your account, and one-time items wait in `/rewards` for you to claim. Offline purchases are reconciled when you next join. Delivery retries and upgrades do not duplicate item rewards already delivered.

### Machinery access

Immediate access to the server-gated functional Create machinery and Sable contraptions. Normal recipes, progression, claim protection and the banned-item rules still apply; this does not grant creative mode or unrestricted administration.

### Items included

1 Creative Blaze Cake for a compatible Create Blaze Burner.

1 Experience Disperser from Relics, delivered fully maxed. When equipped, its dispersion ability shares relic experience across your equipped relics; its rank bonuses also interact with player experience. Normal Relics equipment and ability rules still apply.

### Extra building allowances

+2 home slots, +1 player-owned public warp, +32 claim chunks and +1 force-loadable chunk, added to your natural allowances.

A claim chunk is a 16-by-16 block column protected through FTB Chunks. Force-loading is a separate allowance for selected claimed chunks and remains subject to server chunk-loading rules.

### Using the rewards

Use /rewards to claim the one-time item rewards after delivery. Make room in your inventory before claiming.

Set personal destinations with /sethome <name> and return with /home <name>. Use /pwarp to browse public destinations or /pwarp create <name> to create one on safe ground in your team's claim.

The Discord supporter role is handled by staff after linking your identity. Contact staff privately with your Minecraft name and receipt; do not share payment details in public.

### Commands included

`/craft`

Open a portable crafting table; normal crafting ingredients are still required.

`/stonecutter`

Open a portable stonecutter; normal material costs still apply.

`/nick <name>`

Change your in-game nickname within the server's naming rules; your underlying Minecraft account identity is unchanged.

`/rename <text>`

Rename the item held in your main hand. Supports & color codes; text is limited to 48 characters.

`/disposal`

Open a disposal interface to discard unwanted items. Only place items in it that you intend to throw away.

### Wireless AE2 bundle

1 AE2 Infinity Range Card, 1 Wireless Crafting Terminal, 1 Wireless Access Point, 8 Wireless Boosters and 1 Charger.

The terminal lets you access a linked, powered ME network wirelessly. Configure and power the network and link the terminal as required by AE2. The Infinity Range Card expands supported wireless range; cross-dimension access is the separate Mythic Dimension Card benefit. This bundle does not include a complete ME storage network or stored resources.

### Extra building allowances

+3 home slots, +2 player-owned public warps, +64 claim chunks and +2 force-loadable chunks in total for the Artisan tier, added to your natural allowances. These replace Ember's smaller purchased bonuses rather than stacking a second set of bonuses.

### Travel and priority login

/rtp nether selects a random permitted Nether destination. It shares the 10-minute RTP cooldown and the five-second movement/damage-sensitive warmup. It does not bypass world borders, claims or other destination rules.

Priority login allows eligible players to use up to two reserved places beyond the normal player cap. It does not evict another player, bypass whitelist/bans, or guarantee access while the server is offline or all reserved places are occupied.

Use /pwarp icon <name> <item\_id> to change the display icon of a public warp you own, for example /pwarp icon workshop minecraft:anvil.

### Additional commands

`/echest`

Open your own Ender Chest remotely; this does not open other players' inventories.

`/ascend`

Look for a safe standing space above you in the same dimension and queue a teleport. It fails if no valid space is found.

`/anvil`

Open a portable anvil; vanilla material and experience requirements still apply.

`/smithing`

Open a portable smithing table; templates, equipment and materials are still required.

`/grindstone`

Open a portable grindstone, including its normal repair/disenchant behavior.

`/rtp nether`

Request a random Nether destination under the travel rules above.

`/pwarp icon <name> <item_id>`

Set the menu icon for a public warp you own.

### Travel and flight limits

/rtp end adds random teleporting in the End. Your personal End-eye progression is still required: you must have discovered the required 12 distinct eyes. Buying a rank does not bypass that progression.

/waypoint <x> <y> <z> and supported JourneyMap waypoint teleporting move you to an allowed location in your current dimension. Teleporting requires five seconds without moving or taking damage. The normal destination, claim and border rules still apply.

/fly toggles creative flight anywhere in the world. You can fly in unclaimed areas and across claim boundaries; a claim is not required. Entering combat disables flight, and flight does not bypass block protection or other server rules.

### Additional commands

`/feed`

Refill your hunger and saturation. Five-minute cooldown; unavailable during combat.

`/fly`

Toggle creative flight on or off anywhere, without needing a claim. Double-tap jump to start or stop flying while enabled. Combat disables flight. This grants flight, not Creative mode or unlimited items.

`/waypoint <x> <y> <z>`

Queue a teleport to permitted coordinates in your current dimension. Five-second warmup; two-minute cooldown. Stay still and avoid damage during the warmup.

`/repair`

Repair the damageable item in your main hand while preserving its other components. Costs one XP level per 100 durability repaired, rounded up, with a minimum of one level. Example: 250 damage costs three XP levels.

`/rtp end`

Request a random End destination after meeting personal End-eye requirements.

### AE2 storage and dimension items

1 Infinite Item Storage Cell, delivered empty, plus 1 AE2 Dimension Card.

The storage cell is an item-storage component for a compatible AE2 network; it does not generate items or arrive filled with resources. Install it in compatible network hardware.

The Dimension Card adds the supported cross-dimension wireless capability to your configured AE2 wireless setup. A powered network, linked terminal and compatible hardware are still required. The card itself does not provide chunk loading.

+5 home slots, +5 player-owned public warps, +256 claim chunks and +6 force-loadable chunks in total for the Mythic tier, added to your natural allowances.

### World-wide controls and cosmetics

World time and weather commands affect everyone in your current dimension, not just your own display. Each has its own 30-minute cooldown. Use them considerately and follow staff instructions.

Cosmetic text limits apply: /prefix supports up to 20 characters, /lore up to 100, and /joinmessage up to 80. Cosmetic permissions do not grant moderation powers.

### Additional commands

`/heal`

Restore your health and extinguish fire. Ten-minute cooldown; unavailable during combat or a boss encounter. This does not clear every status effect.

`/effects <effect>`

Choose speed, haste, night\_vision or water\_breathing. Gives the chosen level-I effect for five minutes; all choices share a 15-minute cooldown and cannot be used during combat.

`/prefix <text>`

Set your cosmetic chat prefix, subject to staff rank display and naming rules.

`/chatcolor <color>`

Choose a supported chat text color.

`/lore <text>`

Replace the lore of the item in your main hand with your cosmetic text. Does not change the item's actual abilities.

`/joinmessage <text>`

Set your custom join message within the server's chat rules.

`/worldtime <0-23999>`

Change time in your current dimension. Examples: /worldtime 1000 for daytime or /worldtime 13000 for night. Thirty-minute cooldown.

`/worldweather <clear|rain|thunder>`

Change weather in your current dimension. Example: /worldweather clear. Separate 30-minute cooldown; dimensions without normal weather may not show a weather change.

## Restrictions that apply to every rank

Server rules, banned-item restrictions, claim protection, personal progression and staff moderation apply to everyone. Most player teleports have a five-second warmup that cancels if you move or take damage. Random teleports share a ten-minute cooldown. Entering the End still requires your own 12 distinct eye discoveries.

World resets and service changes can affect builds, items and gameplay; a permanent rank has no scheduled expiry but is not a promise of an unchanged world or indefinite hosting. Read the  [terms](https://mythforge.win/terms/) ,  [refund information](https://mythforge.win/refunds/)  and  [privacy policy](https://mythforge.win/privacy/)  before purchasing.

## Claiming items and getting help

Join with the Minecraft Java account used at checkout and run `/rewards`. Keep inventory space available. For the Runeforged relic choice, claim the voucher and use `/relic` while holding it. If something is missing, keep your receipt and  [contact purchase support](https://mythforge.win/purchase-help/) ; do not purchase again to fix delivery.
